name: 代码走查讲解（How）
description_zh: 讲解某个子系统是怎么运作的：架构、运行时流程、上手心智模型。用于改代码前的代码走查，以及归属/分层问题（这段代码该放哪、哪个包负责）。
description_en: Use for \"how does X work\", code walkthroughs before changing something, and placement / ownership / layering questions (\"where should this live\", \"which package owns this\", \"is this the right layer\"). Explains subsystem architecture, runtime flow, onboarding mental models. Use why for motivation.
